description: Defines the QueueApplication class, a thread-safe event queue-based application implementation with methods for event management, injection, and system event handling.

classes.name: QueueApplication
classes.description: An application class that manages event dispatching using a signaling thread-safe queue.

classes.name: EventQueue
classes.description: A specialized queue for starboard events that deletes heap-allocated events in its destructor.

classes.name: TimedEventQueue
classes.description: Manages timed events with injection, cancellation, and retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: Wake
methods.description: Wakes up GetNextEvent, prompting it to recalculate wait duration.

methods.name: GetNextEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the next event from the queue.

methods.name: Inject
methods.description: Injects an event into the queue.

methods.name: InjectTimedEvent
methods.description: Injects a timed event into the queue.

methods.name: CancelTimedEvent
methods.description: Cancels a timed event by its ID.

methods.name: GetNextDueTimedEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the next timed event that is due.

methods.name: GetNextTimedEventTargetTime
methods.description: Returns the target time for the next timed event.

methods.name: InjectAndProcess
methods.description: Adds an event to the queue and processes events until it is handled.

methods.name: MayHaveSystemEvents
methods.description: Checks if system events can be polled.

methods.name: PollNextSystemEvent
methods.description: Polls for the next system event with zero timeout.

methods.name: WaitForSystemEventWithTimeout
methods.description: Waits for a system event until the specified timeout.

methods.name: WakeSystemEventWait
methods.description: Wakes up threads waiting for system events.

methods.name: PollNextInjectedEvent
methods.description: Polls the event queue for the next event.

methods.name: GetNextInjectedEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the next non-system event, waiting if necessary.
